text: Looking uncovers detail: wherever you look, the world reveals finer structure
description: A core experience goal: looking around should feel like discovering. The periphery stays abstract and coarse; where the gaze rests, the generator adds detail that then stays (it is reprojected with high certainty), so the world gets richer the more you look at it. This turns the foveation and compute limits into the feeling of the game. Uses eye tracking, the detail levels and the per-pixel certainty.

status.comment: First step without eye tracking: `focus` fader (scene tab, default 0 = off). resolve.frag multiplies the scene's colour and depth blend by 1 + focus * exp(-r^2/0.18) around the view centre, so rendered detail gathers where you look and is kept by reprojection. Builds and runs in dev.sh (14.5 ms/frame unchanged). Human step: look around with focus ~5-10, color ~0.01: does detail gather where you look, and does it feel like discovering? Next if yes: drive the centre from the Frame's eye tracking (XR_EXT_eye_gaze_interaction).
